roads.name: Ismay Trading Post Road;County Road G
words: Sweeping and steady: 12 curves in 4.2 miles.

July highs average 96°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 40 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.27 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
